notes.title: The demo will soon be unplayable.
notes.content:
Thank you very much for downloading the demo version.
The demo version of the puzzle game "Conet" will be removed from the store with the full release.
The demo version will be unplayable on June 24, 2021 at noon (Japan time).
Please play it while you still can.

If you have noticed this announcement late, please consider purchasing the full release.
